name: scenity
author: Leonardo Amoroso Custodio
description: Scenity: the 3D scene engine, its editor, the workbench and its host (from CodeBlue frontend/web).

scripts.dev:studio: bun run generate && bun packages/cli/src/cli.ts studio
scripts.build:assets: bun packages/assets/src/build/patchBasis.ts packages/render/src/vendor/basis_transcoder.js && bun packages/assets/src/cli.ts build samples/showroom && bun packages/assets/src/cli.ts build samples/walkthrough && bun packages/assets/src/cli.ts build samples/sim-road
scripts.build:samples: bun packages/cli/src/cli.ts build samples/showroom --check && bun packages/cli/src/cli.ts build samples/characters --check && bun packages/cli/src/cli.ts build samples/spin --check && bun packages/cli/src/cli.ts build samples/physics --check && bun packages/cli/src/cli.ts build samples/walkthrough --check && bun packages/cli/src/cli.ts build samples/sim-road --check
scripts.check:assets: bun packages/assets/src/build/patchBasis.ts packages/render/src/vendor/basis_transcoder.js --check && bun packages/assets/src/build/trimGltf.ts packages/render/src/vendor/GLTFLoader.js --check && bun packages/assets/src/build/trimGltf.ts packages/render/src/vendor/GLTFLoaderGeneric.js --loader generic --check && bun packages/assets/src/build/patchDraco.ts packages/render/src/vendor/draco_wasm_wrapper.js --check && bun packages/assets/src/cli.ts build samples/showroom --check && bun packages/assets/src/cli.ts stills samples/showroom --check && bun packages/assets/src/cli.ts release-check samples/showroom && bun packages/assets/src/cli.ts release-check samples/gltf-samples && bun packages/assets/src/cli.ts build samples/walkthrough --check && bun packages/assets/src/cli.ts build samples/sim-road --check && bun packages/assets/src/cli.ts release-check samples/walkthrough && bun packages/assets/src/cli.ts release-check samples/sim-road
scripts.check:samples: bun packages/cli/src/cli.ts check samples/showroom && bun packages/cli/src/cli.ts check samples/characters && bun packages/cli/src/cli.ts check samples/gltf-samples && bun packages/cli/src/cli.ts check samples/spin && bun packages/cli/src/cli.ts check samples/physics && bun packages/cli/src/cli.ts check samples/walkthrough && bun packages/cli/src/cli.ts check samples/sim-road
scripts.check:shots: bun packages/cli/src/cli.ts shot --project samples/showroom --build --camera front,top --out 'test-results/shot-check/showroom--{camera}.png' --compare 'apps/editor/tests/gallery/__screenshots__/scene-{platform}/showroom--{camera}.png' && bun packages/cli/src/cli.ts shot --project samples/walkthrough --build --sequence sequences/meet.sequence.json --at 9700 --camera front --out test-results/shot-check/walkthrough--meet.png --compare 'apps/editor/tests/gallery/__screenshots__/scene-{platform}/walkthrough--meet.png' && bun packages/cli/src/cli.ts shot --project samples/sim-road --build --sequence sequences/rush.sequence.json --at 12000 --camera front --out test-results/shot-check/sim-road--queue.png --compare 'apps/editor/tests/gallery/__screenshots__/scene-{platform}/sim-road--queue.png'
